deviations: Shop and service shells are 2.8 m walls under a 0.2 m roof slab (3.0 m overall, as B500). Where the +3 west and east galleries pass over a shop, the gallery slab is the roof.

Concrete columns (0.4 m square, 6 m grid) carry the exposed +3 slab edges down to open ground. They are not drawn in B01; each has collision, none sits within 1.8 m of a ground doorway, core aprons cantilever, and the two 24 m bridges stay column-free.
Two five-a-side goals stand against the Cage end fences, offset 5.5 m from the end gates so the B500 gate routes stay open.
A 3 m boundary wall with railings encloses the 144 x 120 m site; the street and skyline beyond are render-only.
The Cage fence (2.6 m, four 4 m gates) blocks movement but not bullets or bot sight, matching the B500 note that the mesh is visually porous.

Dressing adds 136 prop colliders (lamps, bollards, benches, bins and bin stores, shop fittings, roof plant, a fenced substation, sign posts, grit bins, a dumped sofa and washing airers); door arcs, spawns, stair entries and objective rings stay clear.
